analysis: per-label character n-gram language models scored by log-likelihood, against the TF-IDF spaces

design.leave_group_out: the query's leakage group is subtracted from every label it touches before scoring
design.model: interpolated character n-gram model per label, orders 1..N, fixed interpolation weights, add-0.5 unigram floor, n-grams seen fewer than 2 times in the corpus not modelled
design.reference: Peng et al. 2003 (character n-gram LMs for attribution); authorial language models, PLOS One 2025 (per-author GPT-2 read by perplexity)
design.text: the song's cleaned text, lower-cased, whitespace runs folded to one space
design.weights: each song's counts enter its label's model with the builder's per-(group, label) weight

paired_contrasts.design: 2000 replicates, seed 20260825, leakage groups resampled with replacement, each (group, label) component weighted one
